Status planned until the region goes live (Q4 2026); recorded under Ad Dammam per Eastern Province/Dammam sourcing.

Land acquired, pre-construction => planned; 200 MW is campus-maximum program capacity, not live IT load. Grade A- (operator official press release) corroborated by DCD.
